About us

Practical security for anyone with a website to protect

We provide cybersecurity for small businesses, professionals and agencies that run websites and PHP applications. With AI, flaws are found and turned into attacks much faster than before, so the window to patch has narrowed.

We start from what really matters: knowing what software is running, keeping it updated, noticing when something has gone wrong and being able to restart from a backup that works.

How we behave

1Written authorization

We never test systems that do not belong to the client or without a written engagement.

2No invented credentials

We do not claim certifications we do not hold and we do not promise absolute results.

3Price before work

The cost of an engagement is agreed before we begin.
